scenarios.zh: 实际（曾大屋泵房停运） vs 泵房正常
scenarios.en: Actual (Tsang Tai Uk pump house down) vs pump house working
scenarios.desc_zh: A 按沙田区议会记录重演：16 日 08:00 起曾大屋旧村蓄洪池泵房停运，低洼停车场的排水不收水；B 假设泵房照常运转，其余完全相同。
scenarios.desc_en: A replays the Sha Tin District Council record: the Tsang Tai Uk storage-pond pump house down from 08:00 on the 16th, so the low car park does not drain; B assumes the pumps kept running, everything else equal.
